737050102.text: Welcome to the home base of the "Fieldwise Center"!

737050103.text: As you can see, the core projects are already up and running, so we can get to work at any time!

737050104.text: Huh... This feels like... one of those places light novels talk about. Y'know, the adventuring hubs where rookies gather to take quests and stuff?

737050105.text: Oh! And almost like a school festival at the same time, with everyone getting together to learn and then forming teams to hone their skills... Hehe, it's so exciting!

737050108.text: Well, this place isn't quite as decked out as a school festival, but Master Tighnari said the Akademiya plans to be generous with the resources.

737050109.text: Anyway, before students and researchers head out on dangerous field missions, they can come here for advice and emergency training...

737050110.text: We even have professionals on staff that can join their teams to serve as guides or safety personnel.

737050111.text: Yeah, you can think of it like a "Forward Operating Base" — equal parts theoretical training and field practice!

737050112.text: We'll familiarize new recruits with potential challenges in the wild and take them through drills so there's no reason to panic during the real thing!

737050202.text: The internal locomotion mechanism is clever enough, and the execution on the terrain recognition, remote control, and weight detection modules isn't bad...

737050203.text: But, the appearance... It might as well be a doll for a child. No, this won't do...

737050205.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon agreed to join! The Fieldwise Center just leveled up big time, huh?

737050206.text: Hehe! Hello, Madam Faruzan! We're here to help!

737050207.text: Well, look who the cat dragged in...

737050208.text: Excellent job, Collei! Snagging two top experts with undeniable adventuring expertise... Now, the League won't be able to say a word, no matter what kind of feedback I give!

737050209.text: Now, tell me... What do you think of this "Puzzlepal"?

737050210.text: Whoa... It looks just like you!

737050213.text: It's a collaboration between my juniors in the Haravatat Darshan, the Puzzlers' League, and the Synopsium on Ruin Mechanisms.

737050214.text: Clearly, the technological aspect is quite advanced, but the appearance... it couldn't be more childish.

737050215.text: You should've seen Anis! Defending this design choice with more passion than her thesis...

737050245.text: Hmph, young people these days... Far too obsessed with making things cute.

737050217.text: Collei and Amber were just saying how cute companions can help adventurers stay calm.

737050218.text: With a doll that looks like you by her side, Paimon thinks she could go adventuring in a super dark ruin and not even get scared...

737050219.text: Well, that line of thinking does have merit. And, I suppose choosing this particular appearance is a sign of their respect... Ahem, for me.

737050220.text: Still, there are adventurers who place greater emphasis on reliability and technical composition.

737050221.text: People like that don't just want their devices to be able to survive an avalanche, but to look the part... and for their appearance to reflect the high-tech composition.

737050222.text: The fluffiness of this Puzzlepal, on the other hand, doesn't give the impression it would be a reliable or formidable device. The appearance may even be distracting.

737050223.text: Now, picture this... A thick metal casing, square in shape, with a matte finish and openings to showcase the complex technical composition... That would have much more visual impact.

737050224.text: I'm the perfect example of this. I have a youthful appearance, and so people question me on occasion. If I had a head of white hair instead, things would be different.

737050225.text: R—Really? Then, do you want Paimon to talk to them? She has white hair...

737050226.text: What? No! That... That's not the same thing!

737050227.text: Uh... I didn't realize you had such... strict views about this, Madam Faruzan.

737050301.text: This last one is a long-term project we're calling the Security Division.

737050302.text: Thanks to General Mahamatra Cyno, we've been able to bring Dehya on as the instructor and Candace as the coordinator.

737050303.text: They're putting together a combat test right now, but they should be back soon...

737050304.text: Hey! Looking for us? Guess we showed up right on cue, then!

737050305.text: #Wait, {NICKNAME} and Paimon are joining as well? That makes things a whole lot easier!

737050306.text: Sorry for keeping you waiting, everyone, but we managed to bring back some good intel.

737050307.text: Intel? Whew, this is starting to sound intense.

737050310.text: Of course! What better way to protect the students than to sweep through the desert and rid it of all potential dangers! Not a bad plan, right? You in?

737050311.text: Not the best time for jokes, Dehya.

737050312.text: #Besides, when it comes to striking down danger, {NICKNAME} is a {M#man}{F#woman} on a mission. {M#He}{F#She} might take you up on that offer...

737050313.text: #Defeating anything that might pose a threat... Even if {NICKNAME} worked non-stop, that could still take years!

737050314.text: We'd have to stop traveling... Paimon doesn't even wanna think about that...

737050315.text: Time would be the least of our problems. Some dangers aren't visible to the naked eye, like the scorpions burrowed underground, or the terrifying raptors sleeping in the trees...

737050316.text: You can't get rid of them until they jump out to attack you!

737050317.text: For situations like these, we'd have to combine Madam Faruzan's recommendations with Amber's approach to scouting, calculating our chances of encountering enemies and our expected operation times...

737050318.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa. Pencils down, everyone! That was just a joke!

737050319.text: The Security Division's goal is a lot simpler, actually. We're just here to ensure that field work teams include trained combat personnel.

737050320.text: Some of this work has been entrusted to the Blazing Beasts and other mercenaries, but members of investigation teams who pass the combat test can also qualify.

737050321.text: Before an investigation team is allowed to head into a dangerous area, the group must include at least two professionals who have passed the assessment.

737050322.text: And, Dehya and I were just out collecting intel on the best place to hold the test.

737050323.text: We found a Domain filled with monsters and bandits of all levels. Hopefully, they don't mind us borrowing their stomping ground for bit. It'll only cost 'em a few smacks on the head, haha.

737050324.text: Oh, so we just need to supervise, right?

737050325.text: That's right. Participant safety is our utmost priority, so we'll organize a group of capable personnel to take it in shifts.

737050326.text: We still need to figure out our testing metrics, though. Fighting is different from an actual exam — and there's no one right answer.

737050327.text: Mercenaries like me... We all have our own style. That's not a problem in actual combat, but when it comes to teaching... We tend to stick too much to what we're used to.

737050328.text: So we need someone to give us a baseline... someone who has the experience but also takes a more flexible approach in combat.

737050701.text: Hmm... Perhaps we shouldn't change it after all...

737050801.text: Hmm, I should adjust the legs so Bar-drone Bunny can run even faster!
